subject: Highlights, Headwinds, Help: prep for QBR alignment
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 07:12:00 -0800
Subject: Highlights, Headwinds, Help: prep for QBR alignment

Team — quick weekly readout ahead of the QBR (attached one-pager + OKR tracker). I kept this intentionally short; call out anything that needs to be surfaced to execs or adds to the QBR pack.

Highlights:
- PicoHealth expansion: final PO received; onboarding kickoff scheduled 11/3. Expected +$180k ARR incremental. Implementation team estimates 3-week ramp.
- Observability: new per-route tracing landed in staging; token-level latency drop ~12% on 2 test flows.
- Cost initiative: batching + cache recommendations rolled to 10 customers; estimated $14k monthly savings.

Headwinds / Risks:
- Infra backlog: Dedicated GPU patch for KV cache regression still in validation; if delayed past 11/10 we risk slower rollout for Dedicated customers (affects SLA commitments). See incident timeline attached.
- PicoHealth: one outstanding security checklist item (network firewall egress) requiring customer CISO sign-off; delivery could slip ~1 week.
- Sales/Revenue: one mid-market renewal (AcroMedia) flagged pricing objection — opportunity to salvage with limited promotional credit, but needs exec approval if >10% discount.

Help / Asks:
- @Laura — can you take the AcroMedia pricing appeal? If we escalate, we need the finance sign-off and a short rationale to include in the QBR pack by Monday EOD.
- @Jonas — prioritize the Dedicated KV patch validation and give a go/no-go by 11/4. If we need hotfix resources, I'll request a temporary reallocation.
- @Karthik — can you add a one-slide mitigation plan for the PicoHealth firewall item (risk + owner + ETA)?

Attachments: QBR_one-pager.pdf (overview + top asks), OKR_tracker_2026_Q4.xlsx (team-level progress), service_incident_timeline.txt

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Thanks Avery — quick notes inline: 
- AcroMedia pricing: I can take point. I'll pull the last contract and propose a structured concession (cap credit to first 3 months) and circulate to finance by EOD Monday. If they insist on multi-quarter credit, we'll need a signed extension or exec guardrail.
- KV patch: Jonas, if you need engineering cover, I can free up one SRE for a 48-hr focused validation window next week; will only cost a minor shift in oncall rotations.

One more ask: can we add a short customer-impact metric (sessions affected, revenue at risk) to the QBR one-pager? That helps the finance and GTM context.

Laura Bennett
COO | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Highlights, Headwinds, Help: prep for QBR alignment

Agree with Laura. Quick operational update:
- KV cache regression validation currently at 60% of test matrix (edge sequences and long-tail tokens still failing intermittently). ETA to finish full matrix: 11/3 EOD if I can get the extra SRE (thanks Laura).
- If we hit further delays, propose temporary policy: route critical-tier Dedicated traffic to a compatible quantized model variant with autoscaling until patch is fully validated. That reduces throughput but preserves availability.

Avery — give me the green light to proceed with the fallback routing plan in the QBR as the official mitigation; I will prepare a short note explaining performance vs. availability tradeoffs.

Jonas Weber
VP Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
